power.method: 4-wire, powered from the paired indoor monitor

features: auto IR illuminator, ICR auto day/night switch
mechanical call button, multiple bell sounds
local unlock, exit button, door status detection
release_notes: The Dahua VTO1000 (DHI-VTO1000J) is an analog 4-wire villa door station with a 1.3MP camera, 70-degree FOV, auto-IR night vision, DWDR and two-way audio intercom, powered over 4-wire from the paired indoor monitor. Verified against the official Dahua datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: Analog 4-wire door station (CVBS to a Dahua VTH indoor monitor). No IP/ONVIF/RTSP path on the door station itself.
